term_id.description: Stable immutable identifier used for programmatic binding (e.g. data-term-id).

canonical_name.description: Official industry standard or platform concept name.

display_label.description: Exact text string as rendered on screen labels, table headers, or cards.

category.description: Evidence-first taxonomy tier classifying the origin and mathematical authority of the concept.

short_tooltip.description: Concise 1-2 sentence plain-English explanation rendered inside the floating hover tooltip.

plain_english_definition.description: Comprehensive explanation of what the concept means, avoiding circular jargon.

why_it_matters.description: Commercial, legal, or operational impact on the project and stakeholder liabilities.

calculation_rule.description: Exact mathematical equation or deterministic business rule. NULL for non-calculated terms.

limitations_and_boundaries.description: Boundary guardrails defining what the metric does NOT prove, and statutory authority boundaries.

recommended_user_action.description: Practical next step for the user upon viewing this value or triggering this control.

governing_owner.description: Designated professional authority responsible for this definition.
